title: Tatonka Yukon 60+10 Trekking Backpack — 70 L, Adjustable Back System
short_description: A robust trekking backpack with 70 litre volume (60+10), adjustable back system, front access, extra base compartment and integrated rain cover. From German outdoor specialist Tatonka.
long_description: The Tatonka Yukon 60+10 is a proven trekking and travel backpack with 70 litres of total volume. Its adjustable back system can be matched to your own back length and transfers the weight comfortably from the shoulders to the hip belt. The large front access allows convenient packing like a suitcase, the removable base compartment suits a sleeping bag or light gear, and the removable lid pocket can be used separately as a bag. An integrated rain cover protects in bad weather. Ideal for longer tours, trekking and travel.
buying_angle: Practical for trekkers and travellers who want a robust, adjustable backpack with plenty of volume and thoughtful compartments for longer tours.
